notes: Isaac Corre is the founder, CEO, and Portfolio Manager of Governors Lane, a hedge fund he launched in 2015 focused on event-driven strategies. Isaac describes himself as the least likely person to end up on Wall Street, coming to the business from an academic family and a legal background before finding a passion for the business. Our conversation covers where event-driven investing was twenty years ago and where opportunities and challenges lie today across the disciplines of merger arbitrage, event-driven equities, and event-driven credit. Isaac brings the kind of thoughtful and methodical insights to event-driven investing that are required to succeed in the discipline.  Isaac Corre – Event-Driven Investing at Governors Lane (EP.344) Oct 16, 2023

 Isaac Corre is the founder, CEO, and Portfolio Manager of
Governors Lane, a hedge fund he launched in 2015 focused on
event-driven strategies. Isaac describes himself as the least
likely person to end up on Wall Street, coming to the business from
an academic family and a legal background before finding a passion
for the business.

 

Our conversation covers where event-driven investing was twenty
years ago and where opportunities and challenges lie today across
the disciplines of merger arbitrage, event-driven equities, and
event-driven credit. Isaac brings the kind of thoughtful and
methodical insights to event-driven investing that are required to
succeed in the discipline.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
